conventions.coordinates: per-pixel x/y in [0,1] measured along the long viewport side (y=0 top); short axis spans a centred sub-range
conventions.feedback: each frame the previous image is resampled through the warp map, multiplied by decay, then layers are drawn on top; the composite displays the result
conventions.warp_map: source = 0.5+(p-0.5)/zoom^(zoomexp^(2*rad-1)), stretched/rotated about (cx,cy), minus (dx,dy); content therefore moves +dx right, +dy down
conventions.time: seconds since preset start; audio inputs bass/mid/treb are ~1 on average (attenuated *_att variants are smoothed)
conventions.fidelity: approximate recipe for a similar effect, not a pixel-exact specification

description: Approximate source description of "$$$ Royal - Mashup (387).milk". Constructions: feedback transport, rotation, scaling, advection or nonlinear transformation; points/point cloud; independent particles unestablished; polygon/custom-shape primitive; built-in/custom line waveform; angular/cartesian mirror construction: kaleidoscope/symmetry candidate. Colour ingredients: mesh_warp source/feedback palette unresolved; builtin_wave possible source grayscale/red/cyan/blue/purple/pink; wave_0 possible source grayscale/cyan/blue/purple/pink; shape_0 possible source grayscale/cyan/blue/purple/pink; wave_1 possible source orange. Final palette/dominance remain conditional. Native angled_waveform_trace has intrinsic waveform inputs waveform_left; alpha policy: authored wave_a with mode-specific attenuation/boost and optional volume ramp; audio preprocessing/history, displayed contribution and band-specific strength unresolved. Audio routes: bass → zoom; mid → zoom; treble → zoom; attenuated bass → zoom; attenuated mid → zoom; attenuated treble → zoom; bass → radius; bass → opacity; treble → opacity; attenuated treble → colour_r; attenuated treble → colour_g; attenuated treble → colour_b; visible strength unresolved. Nominal unclipped geometry: shape_0 sides 100, configured instances 1; shape_1 sides 100, configured instances 1, signed NDC radius 0.1; shape_2 sides 100, configured instances 1, signed NDC radius 0.5996. Per-pixel warp field (source-mesh-field-structure-v1): zoom varies across the screen with rad; horizontal offset component (combined with zoom/rotation) 0 px/s; vertical offset component (combined with zoom/rotation) 0 px/s. These are per-step sampling-map facts (zoom about the screen centre); visible motion depends on content, decay and composition. Motion vectors: 414 motion vectors (possibly active) on 18 columns x 23 rows; each points toward where the warp sampled content from and is drawn into the feedback image, so it is then warped and decayed with other drawings. Built-in wave colour changes over time: r 0.6-1.4 (at most 0.391/s); g 0.45-0.65 (at most 0.0922/s); b 0.8-1 (at most 0.0914/s); a constant 0.001; closed-form colour over 120 s visits pink 80%, purple 15%, blue 5%; RGB is clamped then max-normalised, so the hue shifts while the brightest channel stays at full. Raw source curves, not observed displayed colours. Borders: darken-centre diamond dims the screen centre by up to 3/32 per frame. Feedback-canvas operators; content moving through the band fades accordingly. wave_0 points (512 per frame) are coloured blue 100%, mean saturation 0.5, mean alpha 0.2; positions are closed-form in sample/time within x -0.522-1.49, y -0.49-1.44 (authored sample grid at declared times; audio held at midpoints; displayed coverage unresolved). wave_2 points (512 per frame) are coloured grayscale 100%, mean saturation 0, mean alpha 0.196; positions are closed-form in sample/time within x 0.0016-0.999, y 0.000132-0.999 (authored sample grid at declared times; audio held at midpoints; displayed coverage unresolved). wave_3 points (100 per frame) are coloured blue 100%, mean saturation 0.3, mean alpha 0; positions are closed-form in sample/time within x 0.0405-0.994, y 0.00182-0.972 (authored sample grid at declared times; audio held at midpoints; displayed coverage unresolved). Source mechanisms: mirror reflection of the sampled image across an axis (composite); the image repeated in tiles across the screen (periodic wrap of the sampling coordinates; mirrored tiles when the wrap alternates) (composite); a custom waveform drawn as points (drawing); a filled or outlined polygon shape (drawing); points whose positions move with sample, time or audio (drawing); a custom line waveform (drawing); a scaling of the previous frame inside the shader (zoom tunnel or expansion) (mesh_warp). Proven program constructions; how prominent each is on screen is conditional. Physical source facts: shape_0 nominal geometry_trajectory upper bound 0 viewport units/second (source_time_partial); shape_1 nominal geometry_trajectory upper bound 0 viewport units/second (source_time_partial); shape_2 nominal geometry_trajectory upper bound 0 viewport units/second (source_time_partial). Motion and brightness facts retain nominal rates/upper bounds and unresolved inputs; typical visible speed and flashing remain unverified. The strict source model records no eligible mood group; approximate LLM estimates remain separate.
